test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Consider the below statements and identify the correct answer.

**Statement - I: **Bleaching powder is used to make drinking water free from germs.

**Statement - II:** Bleaching powder is used as an oxidising agent in many chemical industries.

options.text: Statement - I is true, and Statement - II is false.
Statement - II is true, and Statement - I is false.

solution:
The correct answer is__** Both the statements are true.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**Bleaching powder:

__
 
• It is also known as calcium hypochlorite.
 
• It is commonly used as a disinfectant.
 
• It** works by releasing chlorine when it is dissolved in water**, which kills bacteria and other microorganisms.
 
• The chemical formula of bleaching powder is CaOCl2.
 
• It is a strong oxidizing agent and is **used in many chemical industries as an oxidizing agent.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The process of producing bleaching powder involves the reaction of dry, slaked lime with chlorine gas, which is obtained via the chlor-alkali process.
 
• It is also used to brighten stained clothing in the laundry.
 
• It is important to note that bleaching powder should only be used in small quantities and with caution, as it can be harmful if ingested or inhaled.
